clips.title: The story
paras: Well Stones are small mineral rocks gathered from the banks and surroundings of Mulgore's water wells. Rich in subtle earthen energies, they serve as a vital component in brewing the Water of the Seers during the traditional tauren rites of passage.

Resting naturally in the soft earth bordering the wells of Mulgore, Well Stones absorb the spiritual resonance of the plains and the waters beneath them. Shaman and seers such as Zarlman Two-Moons recognize these stones not as mundane river pebbles, but as receptacles of vital magic. When combined with grounded Ambercorn beneath the plains' mighty trees, their mineral properties temper the brew needed to awaken visionary trance states in young tauren undergoing the sacred Rite of Vision.
